summary: Appeal against High Court's reversal of acquittal; appellate standards for overturning acquittals: must show Trial Court view impossible; High Court failed to analyze witness credibility, Section 149 applicability, or individual roles; delayed FIR, unexplained injuries to accused, lack of investigation into accused's injuries deemed critical; Trial Court's analysis upheld as possible conclusion.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code 1860 s.304(Part I), s.324, s.149
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; acquittal restored.
